name: Shine On
intro: A 16-voice string ensemble in the spirit of the seventies string machines: footages, register filters, a three-line ensemble and a phaser, on OberVave's panel with its two-track sequencer. Turn PRESETS and hold a chord.

rows.what: PERFORM page: TONE, ATTACK, RELEASE, ensemble DEPTH.
Tempo, on every screen.
Pick track A or B.
Octave down (OCT+ up); both together: back to 0.
Lock a held layer open; its button lets it go.
Pick one of 99 programs (1-32 factory sounds).
Arpeggiator mode; OFF switches it off.
On the ARP page: HOLD latches the arp.
A new random string sound.
STRINGS: C.BASS, CELLO, VIOLA, VIOLIN register levels.
BRASS + SPLIT: TRUMPET, HORN, the bass-section split point, TONE.
TONE page: TONE, WARMTH, BRIGHT, VELOCITY.
KEYER: ATTACK (crescendo), RELEASE, VELOCITY, GLIDE.
VIBRATO: RATE, depth, DELAY, mod-wheel depth.
OUTPUT: VINTAGE drift, OCTAVE (16' down / 4' up), BEND, VOLUME.
Full-screen sequencer; tap again for its next view.
Start / stop the sequencer.
Playing: record on top. Stopped: armed, first note starts.
2 seconds: clear the chosen track.
Set a step with the last note or chord; again clears.
Undo the last sequencer change (OCT+: redo).
Switch track B on (16 steps).
Give track B its own sound, e.g. bass under strings.
Mute track A (key 2: B; keys 5 / 6: solo).
Go to pattern 1-8 (playing: at the loop's end).
ENSEMBLE, PHASER, DELAY, REVERB pages; tap for next.
Ensemble: OFF, MONO (as the originals), STEREO, WIDE.
Ensemble mix (KNOB 2 phaser, 3 delay, 4 reverb).
PHASER: RATE, DEPTH, FEEDBK, MIX (off by default).
TRACKS: track B's own sound's FX SEND.
Save the sound in its program slot.
Save the sound into another slot.
In the sequencer: save the pattern now.
Copy this pattern to slot 1-8 (used slot: press twice).
GLOBAL: TEMPO, CLICK, MIDI CH, TUNE.
Click: OFF, REC, ON, COUNT-IN.
MIDI channel or OMNI; the next channel plays B's sound.
Tap tempo (G5).

tips: Start with 01 ENSEMBLE (the classic 8' + 4' strings), 03 SHINE PAD (wide, phased, big plate) and 12 PHASED STR.
The ensemble is the sound: on PERFORM, KNOB 4 (DEPTH) takes it from still to swirling; FX page 1 KNOB 1 picks MONO, STEREO or WIDE.
Registers mix like drawbars: turn VIOLA and VIOLIN down, CELLO up, and the same keys play cellos. SPLIT puts the bass section under the low keys.
An edited sound shows * after its name; turn PRESETS before saving and the edit is gone. SAVE arms for 3 seconds (SAVE?).
Track B can play sound A or its own program; with B chosen and its own sound, the panel edits B (orange B in the header). The effects are sound A's.
Something wrong after an update? Hold OCT- while powering on: USB rescue screen for reinstalling.
checked: v1.2 archive (git archive v1.2), firmware/src/platform.c: FM-1 button enums (BTN_SEL = SEL); line ~451 recovery_key/bootguard_manual: OCT- alone at power-on -> recovery_main.

shn_params.h PAGE table: PERFORM TONE ATTACK RELEASE ENS DEPTH; STRINGS C.BASS CELLO VIOLA VIOLIN; BRASS + SPLIT TRUMPET HORN SPLIT TONE; TONE TONE WARMTH BRIGHT VELOCITY; KEYER ATTACK RELEASE VELOCITY GLIDE; VIBRATO RATE VIBRATO DELAY MOD DPT; OUTPUT VINTAGE OCTAVE BEND VOLUME; ARP; ENSEMBLE MODE DEPTH RATE MIX; PHASER RATE DEPTH FEEDBK MIX (MIX def 0); DELAY; REVERB. NPROG 99, NFACT 32; ENS_NAME OFF MONO STEREO WIDE (def STEREO); OCTAVE -1/0/+1.

shineon.c ~1489-1515: layer buttons SEQ EDIT GLO SAVE FX, tap < 600 ms = pages: EDIT cycle_page(PG_REG1,3), FX cycle_page(PG_ENS,4), GLO GLOBAL <-> OUTPUT (no VOICE page); ENV -> PG_ENV, LFO -> PG_VIB, ARP -> PG_ARP / on it toggles hold; HOME -> PERFORM, with held layer = lock.
shineon.c ~1683: FX layer knobs FXP = ENS_MIX, PHA_MIX, DLY_MIX, REV_MIX. GLOBAL knobs tempo, click, midi_ch (0 OMNI), tune; midi_in ch+1 = track B's sound.

shineon.c: OCT -2..+2, both = 0; EDIT + OCT-/+ undo/redo; PLAY/REC (700 ms tap, 2 s clear); SAVE held + BTN_SEL randomize(); save_armed 3 s, PRESETS picks slot; SAVE tap in sequencer pat_save_to; keys_in: SAVE white 1-8 pat_go, black pat_copy (3 s re-press on used); glo_key 0/1 mute, 4/5 solo, 15 tap tempo; seq_view_turn: track off + KNOB 1 -> 16 steps, TRACKS KNOB 4 B_DRY (FX SEND, B's own sound only); PRESETS with seq_trk = B -> b_set.
shn_patches.h: 32 names; 01 ENSEMBLE, 03 SHINE PAD (WIDE, phaser 70, reverb), 12 PHASED STR (phaser mix 100); shn_engine.h NV 16.
unsure: Not tried on an FM-1 (CLAUDE.md: 1.2 host/OTA/loader-tested only). SEL vs SELECT for the random sound: README says SELECT, code reads BTN_SEL (the SEL button), as on OberVave.

README 'The panel' table and bullets are OberVave's leftovers: HOME = CUTOFF/RESO/ENV AMT/RELEASE, EDIT = OSC/FILTER, GLO = GLOBAL/VOICE/OUTPUT, FX layer = CHORUS/DELAY/REVERB/DELAY TIME. Code: HOME = TONE/ATTACK/RELEASE/DEPTH, EDIT = STRINGS/BRASS+SPLIT/TONE, GLO = GLOBAL/OUTPUT, FX layer = ENSEMBLE/PHASER/DELAY/REVERB mix. Sheet follows the code.

README TRACKS view says KNOB 3 = CUTOFF; code sets P_TONE (label 'TONE'). README says both sounds share 'eight voices' and MONO/UNISON keep four; code has NV 16 and POLY only. README 'any of the 32' for B's sound; PRESETS reaches all 99 slots.
Sequencer step views (STEPS / STEP+ / TRACK / PATTERNS), SEQ black keys = step pages, EDIT layer SHIFT / LENGTH / TRANSPOSE, MIDI CC map (74 tone, 73/72 attack/release): left out as too detailed.
